title: The Orb
description: This short film was made in my Intro to Production class using the bedroom and kitchen set we had access to. We were all given a short treatment, and we all worked on a script based on that treatment as a class. Once we finished the script, all we had to do was film it. I directed all of the scenes in the kitchen. Once filming wrapped, everyone in the class worked on their own individual edits - this is mine.

title: a classic man | a video on MUSIC in MOONLIGHT

title: The Walking Dead Game: A New Frontier (S03E03) - Opening Credits Scene | RESCORE ft. John Paesano
description:
Rescore 1 track: This Is The End - Markus · John Paesano
Rescore 2 track: Finale · John Paesano · Pete Anthony · American Federation of Musicians
Original track: Above the Law Opening Titles · Jared Emerson-Johnson

With Rescore 1 I wanted to enhance that feeling of reminiscence the characters feel when they grab their belongings throughout the house, taking only what they need and leaving their valued items and their past behind. With Rescore 2 I wanted to amp the mood up a bit, and give it a feel of "gearing up" and "preparing for what's to come," which is kind of what the original had, while still leaving a bit of reflection as each character leaves their home.. I just now realized that both of these tracks are composed by John Paesano.

0:00 Timestamps
0:05 Rescore 1
2:22 Rescore 2
